notes.title: 【Update】Language Support Now Available for Tied by Your Red
notes.notes:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and patience. [i]Tied by Your Red[/i] now officially supports [b]Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English[/b]. You can switch between these languages freely in the main menu for a more complete gameplay experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41459652/3cac375aaa19f6e3fecc7cfa50c2bdce98e545d2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]About the Mac Version[/b]
At present, [b]only the Windows version supports multilingual switching[/b]. Due to unresolved technical issues causing crashes in the Mac version after the update, it currently remains in [b]its original Traditional Chinese version[/b]. We will release an update for Mac once the issues are resolved.[/p][p][b]Upcoming Collaboration Event[/b]
We will soon announce details of a limited-time collaboration event with our partners—please stay tuned![/p][p]Thank you once again for your support and understanding. Enjoy the game![/p][p]Sincerely,
The Development Team[/p]
